quote: the equivalent of 200,000 tons of TNT exploding over Eleventh and F streets N.W.
notes: SECONDARY: named only by a 1955 newspaper (wire story), not by an FCDA document opened. Burst type: air burst per Evening Star 16 Jun 1955 p.4 ("a rather small bomb that burst high in the air. source_doc: The Nome Nugget (Nome, Alaska), 17 June 1955, p.3, AP story "History Making Disaster Rehearsal Leaves 5,000,000 Americans 'Dead'" (Chronicling America sn84020662, OCR)
quote: In New Orleans, one of the seven cities which did not know in advance whether it would be a target area or supporting city, the make-believe blast killed 36,023 and injured 12,619.
